sample_added: New Routes, New Possibilities! The journey towards stronger regional air connectivity begins at Routes Asia 2027 @routesonline. AAI brings together the global aviation community to explore new route development opportunities, forge strategic partnerships and strengthen regional air connectivity. Join us 16–18 March 2027 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

Pawan Hans Launches Joy Ride Services at Srikakulam on the Auspicious Occasion of Kotabommali Kothammathalli Festival. Pawan Hans Limited launched Joy Ride services at Srikakulam on 13 October 2026, on the auspicious occasion of the Kotabommali Kothammathalli Festival, in the esteemed presence of the Hon’ble Union Minister of Civil Aviation, Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu and Shri Kinjarapu Atchannaidu, Hon’ble Minister for Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development & Fisheries, Government of Andhra Pradesh. The launch ceremony was graced by Shri Sunil Kumar Nagdawne, Chairman & Managing Director, Pawan Hans Limited, along with Team Pawan Hans*. The special three-day service offers festival visitors a unique opportunity to experience the thrill of helicopter rides as part of the festive celebrations. Through this initiative, Pawan Hans Limited reinforces its presence at the regional level by extending helicopter services during important local festivals and special occasions. This initiative reflects the organisation’s commitment to bringing helicopter services closer to regional communities and catering to seasonal travel demand during festive occasions. Pawan Hans – We Fly for You! 🚁 #PawanHans #Srikakulam #JoyRide #KotabommaliKothammathalliFestival #CivilAviation #HelicopterServices #RegionalConnectivity @Pib_MoCA @MoCA_GoI @AAI_Official @Sunil_Nagdawne @RamMNK

Airports Authority of India observed the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction across its airports under the theme “Resilience Starts at Home” to strengthen disaster preparedness, risk mitigation and emergency response mechanisms. At AAI’s Corporate Headquarters, New Delhi, a meeting chaired by Shri Puneet Kansal, Chairman, AAI, was convened to review disaster preparedness measures, update Disaster Management Plans, assess the readiness of emergency equipment and strengthen coordination among stakeholders. The initiative underscores AAI’s continued commitment to enhancing safety, preparedness and resilience across airport operations.
Make in India, Make for the World 🇮🇳 India’s growing role in the global aerospace supply chain reflects the strength of our manufacturing capabilities. https://t.co/3CO61uz5vY

@AAI_Official under its CSR initiative is supportening CAD/CAM skill development project at ACIC IIT (ISM) Foundation, Dhanbad. 26 students received certificates on completing the 1st batch, with 60 students to benefit across 2 batches, empowering youth through technical skills. https://t.co/gkBMKVPCOU

Hosted by Airports Authority of India, Routes Asia 2027 @routesonline brings the aviation ecosystem together to unlock new routes, boost tourism and trade, attract investments, create employment opportunities, and strengthen regional growth. Save the date for the big event! 16–18 March 2027 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

West Bengal is set to get better air connectivity with four new airports and expanded air operations across the state. These efforts will make travel easier, connect more people and open up new opportunities for communities across the region. @RamMNK @mohol_murlidhar @samirsinha69 @AAI_Official @Pib_MoCA

Committed to serving people in their moments of greatest need, AAI continues to play a vital role in facilitating timely medical assistance and ensuring connectivity for the people of Lakshadweep. Every life is precious, and serving humanity remains at the heart of our commitment.
